feature_logic: 停損 OpeningRange low/回落/13:20 時間退出
同日強制平倉(last-bar fallback; T0 收斂對應 Overnight Gate; 13:25 label=簡稱, 實為 13:20 時間退出+同日末bar)
PIT: signal 用當日盤中資訊, entry next-minute open, 無 future leak
honest_conclusion: 開盤競價突破當日沖銷(盤中, 非隔夜) 實測: IS/OOS 皆 gross 負(IS -240%/OOS -221%) => 訊號本身無 edge (win 11-13%, 非成本問題; 對比隔夜 rf 有edge但成本吃掉). 依 DOC-20 判 REJECTED/失敗是資產. 49 權值股/1y 樣本代表性限制已標註.

root_cause.primary: signal no edge pre-cost (開盤競價突破 in this 49-symbol sample fades/whipsaws)
root_cause.evidence: gross IS -240.2% / OOS -221.1% (already negative before 68.5bp cost), win 11-13%
root_cause.not_cost: gross negative => 非成本問題 (對比隔夜 rf: 有edge但成本吃掉)
root_cause.paper_shadow: NOT_INITIATED (缺正期望, DOC-20/25 不強推)

representativeness: 49 大型權值股 + 單一 SHIOAJI provider + ~1y 窗口 + TWSE_OR_TPEX; 不含中小股/試撮完整深度 -> 開盤競價突破 in large-cap sample 較難有 edge; 誠實標註, 不可外推到全市場

representativeness_caveats.single_provider: 全部資料來自單一 provider SHIOAJI (2793223 rows)
representativeness_caveats.survivorship_bias: 49 檔為現存權值股(1101/2881/2303 等), 含 survivorship 偏誤; 不含已下市/中小股
representativeness_caveats.sparse_bar_filter: 當日 <60 根 minute bar 之樣本被過濾(len<60 no trade)
representativeness_caveats.venue: TWSE_OR_TPEX 混; 未區分試撮完整訂單簿深度
representativeness_caveats.impact: 以上限制使結果不可外推至全市場/全時段; 但不改變 gross 為負(訊號無 edge)之結論
